# LLM Toolkit

> Free, privacy-first tools for developers working with GPT-5, Claude and Gemini APIs. Every tool runs 100% in your browser — no sign-up, no data collection. All pricing data is verified against official provider pages and dated.

## Key facts

- 1,000 tokens ≈ 750 English words (0.75 words per token, ~4 characters per token)
- Cheapest production API (verified Aug 2026): GPT-5 nano at $0.05 per 1M input tokens / $0.40 per 1M output
- Largest context window (verified Aug 2026): Gemini family and Claude 5 series at 1M tokens; GPT-5 family at 400K; Claude Haiku 4.5 at 200K
- Cached input costs ~10% of normal input rates on Claude, Gemini and the GPT-5 family; older OpenAI models (GPT-4o, o3) cache at 25–50%
- Pricing table is re-verified against official provider pages monthly; each row carries its verification date

## Tools

- [AI Token Counter](https://llmtoolkit.dev/tools/token-counter/): Count tokens for any text using OpenAI's exact o200k tokenizer (GPT-5/4o precise) with per-model estimates for Claude and Gemini. Shows real-time cost and context-window usage.
- [LLM API Pricing Comparison](https://llmtoolkit.dev/tools/llm-pricing/): Sortable table of 22 models — input, cached input, output rates per 1M tokens plus context windows, every row dated and verified.
- [LLM Context Window Comparison](https://llmtoolkit.dev/tools/context-window/): All context windows visualized, with approximate word/page counts and what it costs to fill each window.
- [LLM API Cost Calculator](https://llmtoolkit.dev/tools/cost-calculator/): Enter request volume, token sizes and cache hit rate — get the monthly bill for every model at once, sorted by cost.
- [Token ↔ Words Converter](https://llmtoolkit.dev/tools/token-words/): Convert tokens to words and back, with a reference table from 100 to 1M tokens including page counts and which model windows fit.

## Model comparisons

- [Comparison hub — all 16 head-to-head pages](https://llmtoolkit.dev/compare/)
- [GPT-5 vs Claude Opus 5](https://llmtoolkit.dev/compare/gpt-5-vs-claude-opus-5/)
- [GPT-5 mini vs Claude Sonnet 5](https://llmtoolkit.dev/compare/gpt-5-mini-vs-claude-sonnet-5/)
- [GPT-5 nano vs Claude Haiku 4.5](https://llmtoolkit.dev/compare/gpt-5-nano-vs-claude-haiku-4-5/)
- [GPT-5 vs Gemini 3.5 Flash](https://llmtoolkit.dev/compare/gpt-5-vs-gemini-3-5-flash/)
- [GPT-5 vs GPT-5 mini](https://llmtoolkit.dev/compare/gpt-5-vs-gpt-5-mini/)

Each comparison includes per-token rates, cached rates, context windows, and monthly cost modeled at three real workloads (side-project chatbot, coding agent, bulk extraction).

## Model profiles

- [Model directory — all 22 model profile pages](https://llmtoolkit.dev/models/): one page per tracked model with verified rates, context window in words/pages, cost-to-fill, and monthly cost at three real workloads.
- [GPT-5 profile](https://llmtoolkit.dev/models/gpt-5/) — $1.25 in / $10.00 out per 1M, 400K context
- [GPT-5 mini profile](https://llmtoolkit.dev/models/gpt-5-mini/) — $0.25 in / $2.00 out per 1M, 400K context
- [Claude Sonnet 5 profile](https://llmtoolkit.dev/models/claude-sonnet-5/) — $2.00 in / $10.00 out per 1M, 1M context
- [Claude Opus 5 profile](https://llmtoolkit.dev/models/claude-opus-5/) — $5.00 in / $25.00 out per 1M, 1M context
- [Gemini 3.5 Flash profile](https://llmtoolkit.dev/models/gemini-3-5-flash/) — $1.50 in / $9.00 out per 1M, 1M context

Every profile cites its verification date and links to the provider's official pricing page.
